description: What a fax costs on FaxUp, optionally for a given fax number and page count. Checks the number can be faxed (country served, not a mobile line). Read-only; charges nothing.

country.description: ISO country code for a number given without "+", e.g. "GB".

pages.description: Pages in the document, if known.

to_number.description: Fax number in international form, e.g. "+1 202 555 0143" or "+44 20 7123 4567". Without a "+" it is read as US/Canada, or as `country`.

name: get_price_quote
title: Get a fax price quote
